content:
katie-events: Quick sync — finalizing reg page + Zoom for Benchmark webinar Thu. Need fields, Zoom cohosts, recording/transcript policy, post-event email, and lead routing.

oliver-growth: Reg page recs: keep fields minimal (name, work email, company, role). Add a dropdown: 'primary use case' + hidden UTM fields. Avoid >2 open text boxes to reduce dropoff.

maria-marketing: Agreed. Also add an opt-in checkbox: 'I consent to receive the recording and follow-ups'. That lets us be GDPR-friendly. I'll draft the 24h + 3-day follow-up cadence.

sam-martech: Zapier/Marketo plan: on registration webhook -> enrich IP -> append utm_campaign/utm_source -> create lead in Marketo. High-intent filter (role contains "Engineer" OR company_size > 50) -> SFDC AE queue. Low intent -> nurture program. Example mapping:
```
form.email -> lead.Email
form.name -> lead.Name
form.company -> lead.Company
form.role -> lead.Role
hidden.utm_campaign -> lead.Campaign
opt_in_recording -> lead.Consent
```

katie-events: Zoom settings: enable cloud recording + audio transcript, record active speaker + gallery, automatic recording on. Legal asked about retention — propose auto-delete after 90 days unless compliance flag. Set co-hosts = oliver-growth, maria-marketing. Also enable 'allow host to unmute participants' for demo segment.

oliver-growth: I'll co-host. For lead routing: tag leads with source=webinar and utm_campaign=benchmark-q2. Add a tag "high-intent" when role matches and company size >50. Send high-intent leads to sales-inbox Slack channel + AE assignment.

sam-martech: I can wire the Slack alert via Zap: SFDC new lead with tag high-intent -> post to #sales-inbox with lead link + basic fields. Follow-up sequence: 24h (recording + CTA), 3 days (survey + ask for feedback), 2 weeks (case study + trial CTA).

zoom-bot: Reminder: Meeting "Redwood Benchmarking" scheduled Thu 2026-04-23 11:00 UTC. Cloud recording: ON, Transcription: ON.

katie-events: Perfect. Maria — can you paste the short 24h email copy here? Also can we put an 'Add to calendar' iCal link on the confirmation page and include it in the confirmation email.

maria-marketing: 24h email draft:
"Hi {{first_name}},
Thanks for joining the Benchmark webinar — recording is ready: <recording link>. Quick recap + 2-minute survey: <survey link>. Want a tailored cost/latency estimate? Reply and we'll schedule 15m.
— Redwood Team"

oliver-growth: :thumbsup: Love the short CTA.

sam-martech: Deploying test zap and webhook now. I'll run an internal registration for QA and confirm Marketo lead fields + Slack alert. ETA ~2h. If anyone wants to test, use test+webinar@redwood.test.

katie-events: Thanks all — follow-ups: Maria finalize email, Sam run tests and confirm AE routing, Oliver prepare 1-slide benchmarking CTA. I'll update the reg page with hidden UTMs and add the calendar link.
